audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagrees with the packet chart at four rows. Content/full read Skill/Vayne/Vayne/Skill/Skill/Vayne/Vayne; the packet reads Vayne/Vayne/Graves/Skill/Graves/Vayne/Vayne. The whys[] prose agrees with the packet everywhere: whys[0] says you cannot punish at 1, whys[2] calls level 3 'your strongest trade', whys[4] calls level 6 'your best window'.
audit.why: 43.9% win rate with two clear Graves windows — the chart was hiding both of them and inventing a level-1 coin flip that the text itself denies.
audit.corrected: win[0]=Vayne, win[2]=Graves, win[4]=Graves (win[1], win[3], win[5], win[6] already matched); phases sides and ratings aligned to the same chart.

audit.why: Spikes are correctly placed at 1, 3, 6 and 2+ items and match the kits — Tumble falling from 6s to 2s and Final Hour's Tumble invisibility are exactly why the late game inverts.
audit.corrected: Tumble's real cooldowns added where the advice says 'wait for her tumble'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Smoke Screen 'blinds' Vayne's auto in five separate places (whys[2], whys[4], spikes[1], early, mid, wants.you[0]). Graves' W is not a blind — Riot's text is 'a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range', a nearsight plus a brief impact slow. It denies her vision of you, it does not stop her attacking. Separately, 'second Quickdraw charge' appears twice; Quickdraw has no charges in the kit — it is a single 16/15/14/13/12s dash whose cooldown is lowered by landing basic attacks. 'End of the Line (Q) cone' is also wrong: the cone is Collateral Damage (R); Q detonates after 1 second or on terrain.
audit.why: A player who believes W blinds will stand in the smoke and eat three Silver Bolts stacks. A player who believes E has two charges will spend the first one on damage expecting a second for the exit.
audit.corrected: W described as cutting her sight; E described as one dash refreshed by landing autos; Q described as a shell, not a cone.

audit.why: Condemn at 20/18/16/14/12s is the right cooldown to schedule around and the page already does.
Common mistakes are behavioural and not split by elo.

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.
edits.after: One ability, two shells and no dash — she tumbles out of your spread and chips you, so last-hit and eat it.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Condemn; your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Condemn's 20s at rank 1 — her third-hit true damage ignores your grit.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: Silver Bolts true damage ignores every resist you stack and Final Hour kites you — take picks, never the 1v1.

edits.before: With Q, W and E online you Quickdraw in, blind her kite auto with Smoke Screen and unload the point-blank shell spread plus End of the Line cone — your strongest trade.
edits.after: With Q, W and E online you Quickdraw in, drop Smoke Screen so she cannot see you, and unload the point-blank shell spread plus End of the Line — your strongest trade.

edits.before: Your True Grit resists and second Quickdraw charge make you sturdy, but her third-hit Silver Bolts true damage ignores armor, so the 4-5 window stays even rather than yours.
edits.after: True Grit resists and a Quickdraw refreshed by your own autos make you sturdy, but third-hit Silver Bolts is true damage, so the 4-5 window stays even rather than yours.

edits.before: Collateral Damage off a Quickdraw gap-close with Smoke Screen blinding her escape is a one-shot kill if her tumble (Q) or Flash is down — your best window in the lane.
edits.after: Collateral Damage off a Quickdraw gap-close, with Smoke Screen killing her sight, is a one-shot kill if Tumble (4s at rank 3) or Flash is down — your best window in lane.

edits.before: With Q, W and E up you finally commit: Quickdraw (E) in, drop Smoke Screen (W) on her to blind the kite auto, then unload the point-blank 4-shell spread plus the End of the Line (Q) cone — your one clean burst window.
edits.after: With Q, W and E up you finally commit: Quickdraw (E) in, drop Smoke Screen (W) on her so she loses sight of you, then unload the point-blank 4-shell spread plus the End of the Line (Q) shell — your one clean burst window.

edits.before: Hit level 3 and Quickdraw (E) in with Smoke Screen (W) blinding her tumble auto for a point-blank shell spread plus End of the Line (Q) burst
edits.after: Hit level 3 and Quickdraw (E) in with Smoke Screen (W) cutting her sight for a point-blank shell spread plus End of the Line (Q) burst

edits.before: Level 1 is rough — you have one ability, a 2-shell magazine, and no Quickdraw (E) yet, so you cannot close on a Vayne who tumbles (Q) to reposition and chips your short range from outside your shell spread. Last-hit with the edge of your range and accept the chip. Your turn comes at level 3: once Q, W and E are all up, you Quickdraw in, drop Smoke Screen (W) directly on her to blind the auto she tries to kite with, and unload the point-blank 4-shell spread plus the End of the Line (Q) cone. That is your one clean trade pattern — do not throw it on cooldown; wait until her tumble (Q) is already down so she cannot dodge your dash and reposition out of the blind.
edits.after: Level 1 is rough — you have one ability, a 2-shell magazine, and no Quickdraw (E) yet, so you cannot close on a Vayne who tumbles (Q) to reposition and chips your short range from outside your shell spread. Last-hit with the edge of your range and accept the chip. Your turn comes at level 3: once Q, W and E are all up, you Quickdraw in, drop Smoke Screen (W) directly on her so she cannot see where you are, and unload the point-blank 4-shell spread plus the End of the Line (Q) shell. That is your one clean trade pattern — do not throw it on cooldown; wait until Tumble (Q) is down, 6s at rank 1 and 4s at rank 3, so she cannot dodge your dash.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are even at best — your True Grit passive stacking armor and second Quickdraw charge make you sturdy, but resists do nothing against her third-hit Silver Bolts (W) true damage, so do not sit in a long fight thinking you out-stat her. Level 6 is your real window: Collateral Damage (R) is a big nuke that, off a Quickdraw gap-close with Smoke Screen blinding her escape auto, can flat-kill her if her tumble (Q) or Flash is down. Force that all-in the instant you hit 6. If you whiff it, you have handed her the lane and the scaling clock starts running in her favor.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are even at best — True Grit armor and a Quickdraw whose cooldown your own autos shorten make you sturdy, but resists do nothing against her third-hit Silver Bolts (W) true damage, so do not sit in a long fight thinking you out-stat her. Level 6 is your real window: Collateral Damage (R) is a big nuke that, off a Quickdraw gap-close with Smoke Screen cutting her sight, can flat-kill her if Tumble (Q) or Flash is down. Force that all-in the instant you hit 6. If you whiff it, you have handed her the lane and the scaling clock starts running in her favor.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Your W smoke nearsights tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.

notes: The 'Smoke Screen blinds' error is not local to Vayne — it is boilerplate repeated across Graves matchups (it also appeared verbatim in the urgot page's early text and in report[10], which is champion-level template copy). Riot's W text is a sight-range reduction plus an impact slow; nothing in the kit supports a blind. Recommend a global sweep of Graves pages for the words 'blind' and 'second Quickdraw charge'. Level-chart flips are proposed as one atomic group.
